next:wr:890.hint: 彼はもうその痛みに耐えられない
next:wr:890.answer: He can stand the pain no longer.
next:wr:890.fullSentence: He can stand the pain no longer.
next:wr:890.explanation: stand A ＝ endure, put up with, tolerate『Aを我慢する』。
next:wr:890.relatedInfo: can't stand Aで『Aに耐えられない』とよく使う。

next:wr:892.hint: そのホテルは湾の素晴らしい景色を見渡せる
next:wr:892.answer: The hotel commands a fine view of the bay.
next:wr:892.fullSentence: The hotel commands a fine view of the bay.
next:wr:892.explanation: command a view of A『Aを見渡せる』。
next:wr:892.relatedInfo: 建物の立地が見晴らしの良さを表す言い方。

next:wr:894.hint: 彼が時間通りに現れるかどうかと思う
next:wr:894.answer: I wonder if he will show up on time.
next:wr:894.fullSentence: I wonder if he will show up on time.
next:wr:894.explanation: I wonder if/whether S V『〜かどうかと思う』。
next:wr:894.relatedInfo: 疑問を表す動詞wonderの基本用法。

next:wr:896.hint: またすぐに会えることを望んでいる
next:wr:896.answer: I hope to see you again soon.
next:wr:896.fullSentence: I hope to see you again soon.
next:wr:896.explanation: hope to V『〜することを望む』。hope (that S V)、hope for 〜も同じ動詞の異なる形。
next:wr:896.relatedInfo: hope for a good result のように名詞を続けることもできる。

next:wr:898.hint: その会社はもっとスタッフを雇うことにした
next:wr:898.answer: The company decided to hire more staff.
next:wr:898.fullSentence: The company decided to hire more staff.
next:wr:898.relatedInfo: アメリカ英語ではhireは主に人を雇うことに使う。

next:wr:900.hint: そのチームは5人のメンバーから成る
next:wr:900.answer: The team consists of five members.
next:wr:900.fullSentence: The team consists of five members.
next:wr:900.explanation: A consist(s) of B『AはBから成る』。
next:wr:900.relatedInfo: be made up of B、compriseと同義。

next:wr:902.explanation: A comprise(s) B『AはBから成る』(consist of/be made up ofと同義)。
next:wr:902.relatedInfo: comprise ofとは言わない(前置詞不要)。

next:wr:904.hint: このボトルには2リットルの水が入っている
next:wr:904.answer: This bottle contains two liters of water.
next:wr:904.fullSentence: This bottle contains two liters of water.
next:wr:904.explanation: contain ~『(容器や場所に)〜を含む、内容物』。

next:wr:906.hint: どちらを選んでも私にとってはどちらでもよい
next:wr:906.answer: It makes no difference to me which one you choose.
next:wr:906.fullSentence: It makes no difference to me which one you choose.
next:wr:906.explanation: It makes no difference (to me) wh~『(私にとって)〜はどちらでもよい』。
next:wr:906.relatedInfo: It doesn't matter (to me) wh~とほぼ同義。

next:wr:908.answer: I had a strange dream last night.
next:wr:908.fullSentence: I had a strange dream last night.
next:wr:908.relatedInfo: seeではなくhaveを使う点に注意。

next:wr:910.hint: 留学中、私は故郷が恋しかった
next:wr:910.answer: I really missed my hometown while studying abroad.
next:wr:910.fullSentence: I really missed my hometown while studying abroad.
next:wr:910.explanation: miss A『Aがなければ〜できない、Aがなくて寂しい』。
next:wr:910.relatedInfo: ⇔catch(捕まえる、乗り遅れない)との対比。

next:wr:912.hint: 彼のコメントは私には失礼に感じられた
next:wr:912.answer: His comment struck me as rude.
next:wr:912.fullSentence: His comment struck me as rude.
next:wr:912.explanation: strike A as B『AがBと感じられる』。

next:wr:914.hint: 窓を開けてもよいですか
next:wr:914.answer: Do you mind if I open the window?
next:wr:914.fullSentence: Do you mind if I open the window?
next:wr:914.explanation: Do you mind if I do...?『〜してもよいですか』。
next:wr:914.relatedInfo: 直訳は『私が〜すると嫌ですか』なので、承諾はNoで答える。

next:wr:916.hint: この計画にはいくつか問題があると思う
next:wr:916.answer: I expect there to be some problems with this plan.
next:wr:916.fullSentence: I expect there to be some problems with this plan.
next:wr:916.explanation: expect there to be A『Aがあると思う』。There is構文の不定詞化。
next:wr:916.relatedInfo: believe/want there to be Aも同じ構文。

next:wr:918.hint: チームにもっと多様性があってほしい
next:wr:918.answer: I want there to be more diversity in the team.
next:wr:918.fullSentence: I want there to be more diversity in the team.
next:wr:918.explanation: want there to be A『Aがあってほしい』。
next:wr:918.relatedInfo: expect/believe there to be Aと同じパターン。

next:wr:920.hint: お金持ちであることが幸せであるということにはならない
next:wr:920.answer: Being rich doesn't follow that you are happy.
next:wr:920.fullSentence: Being rich doesn't follow that you are happy.
next:wr:920.explanation: It doesn't follow that ~『〜ということにはならない』。
next:wr:920.relatedInfo: 論理的な帰結ではないことを表す。

next:wr:921.hint: 彼はこの街に多くの友人がいる(可算名詞の複数形)
next:wr:921.answer: He has many friends in this city.
next:wr:921.fullSentence: He has many friends in this city.
next:wr:921.explanation: many『多くの』(可算名詞の複数形につく)。
next:wr:921.relatedInfo: much(不可算名詞)との使い分け。

next:wr:923.hint: そのイベントにはかなり多くの人がいた
next:wr:923.answer: There were quite a few people at the event.
next:wr:923.fullSentence: There were quite a few people at the event.
next:wr:923.explanation: a few『少しの』/ quite a few『かなり多くの』。quiteがつくと意味が強まる。
next:wr:923.relatedInfo: a fewは肯定的なニュアンス。

next:wr:925.hint: 締め切りまでほとんど時間が残っていない(否定的)
next:wr:925.answer: We have little time left before the deadline.
next:wr:925.fullSentence: We have little time left before the deadline.
next:wr:925.explanation: little『少ない』(不可算名詞、否定的)。
next:wr:925.relatedInfo: a little(肯定的)との違いに注意。

next:wr:927.hint: かなり多くの学生がその難しい試験に合格した(可算名詞)
next:wr:927.answer: Not a few students passed the difficult exam.
next:wr:927.fullSentence: Not a few students passed the difficult exam.
next:wr:927.explanation: not a few『かなり多くの(可算名詞)』。
next:wr:927.relatedInfo: 『少なくない』が転じて『かなり多い』の意味になる。

next:wr:930.hint: 彼はとても分別のある人だ、考えずに行動することは決してない
next:wr:930.answer: He is a very sensible person; he never acts without thinking.
next:wr:930.fullSentence: He is a very sensible person; he never acts without thinking.
next:wr:930.explanation: sensible『分別がある』⇔sensitive『敏感な』。混同しやすい形容詞のペア。
next:wr:930.relatedInfo: sensitiveは『感受性が強い、敏感な』の意味。

next:wr:932.hint: 彼は町の立派な、ちゃんとした家系の出身だ
next:wr:932.answer: He comes from a respectable family in the town.
next:wr:932.fullSentence: He comes from a respectable family in the town.
next:wr:932.relatedInfo: respectful(礼儀正しい)、respective(それぞれの)との違いに注意。

next:wr:934.hint: この地域は産業地帯に発展した
next:wr:934.answer: This region has grown into an industrial area.
next:wr:934.fullSentence: This region has grown into an industrial area.
next:wr:934.explanation: industrial『産業の』⇔industrious『勤勉な』。混同しやすい形容詞のペア。

next:wr:936.hint: たくさんの学生がこの問題に苦しんできた(単数扱い)
next:wr:936.answer: Many a student has struggled with this problem.
next:wr:936.fullSentence: Many a student has struggled with this problem.
next:wr:936.explanation: many a/an + 単数名詞『たくさんの〜(形は単数扱い)』。
next:wr:936.relatedInfo: 動詞は単数扱いになる点に注意(has)。

next:wr:938.hint: 多くの来場者がその祭りに来た(可算名詞)
next:wr:938.answer: A large number of visitors came to the festival.
next:wr:938.fullSentence: A large number of visitors came to the festival.
next:wr:938.explanation: a large number of A『多くのA(可算名詞)』。
next:wr:938.relatedInfo: a good deal of A(不可算名詞用)との対比。
